title: Implement glob-not `-G`
body:
New options  `-G` / `--glob-not` are added as a negation of `-g` / `--glob`:

Closes #3522

E.g. `-G tests` is equivalent to `-g '!tests'`

Moreover, negation of glob-not is also possible in case:

E.g. `-G '!tests' is equivalent to `-g tests``

This is inspired as analogous to how `-T/--type-not` relates to `-t/--type`
